description: Prompt configuration for reusable mood-based quote backgrounds. Select exactly one coherent style profile and one quote layout. All visual choices must come from the selected style profile.

inputs.tag: Mood or emotional tag, for example serene, melancholic, transcendent, ominous, joyful

template: {{medium}} intended as a reusable background for quotations sharing a {{tag}} mood. Visual style: {{look}}. {{texture}}. {{composition}} {{quoteInstruction}} Express the {{tag}} mood through colour, lighting, spatial feeling, form, atmosphere, and intensity while preserving the selected visual style. Maintain a strong, intentional art direction rather than generic concept art. The image should function as an atmospheric background rather than as a poster or self-contained narrative scene. No generated typography.

quoteLayouts.instruction: Reserve a generous low-detail region in the interior left side of the image for quotation text, beginning well inside the image margins. Keep this area atmospheric and visually integrated rather than making an obvious blank rectangle. Push the strongest focal detail, contrast, and complex forms toward the right side.
quoteLayouts.composition: Use an asymmetrical composition whose visual energy gradually decreases toward the left quote area.

quoteLayouts.instruction: Reserve a generous low-detail region in the interior right side of the image for quotation text, ending well before the outer edge. Keep this area atmospheric and visually integrated rather than making an obvious blank rectangle. Push the strongest focal detail, contrast, and complex forms toward the left side.
quoteLayouts.composition: Use an asymmetrical composition whose visual energy gradually decreases toward the right quote area.

quoteLayouts.instruction: Reserve a generous low-detail region across the upper interior portion of the image for quotation text, leaving comfortable margins above and at the sides. Keep the region part of the image rather than making a blank panel. Concentrate stronger forms and focal detail primarily below it.
quoteLayouts.composition: Use vertical depth and visual weight in the lower half, fading into a calmer upper quote region.

quoteLayouts.instruction: Reserve a broad low-detail region around the interior center of the image for quotation text. Surround it indirectly with atmosphere, light, texture, or abstract forms without creating a visible rectangular frame. Keep important focal elements away from the central quote area.
quoteLayouts.composition: Arrange visual interest around the outer and off-centre regions while maintaining an integrated calm central zone.

quoteLayouts.instruction: Reserve a generous low-detail region across the lower interior portion of the image for quotation text, leaving comfortable space before the lower and side edges. Keep this region atmospheric rather than blank. Concentrate stronger focal detail primarily above it.
quoteLayouts.composition: Use visual weight in the upper and middle regions, fading toward a calmer lower quote region.

quoteLayouts.instruction: Do not reserve a specific area for quotation text. The quotation will be displayed separately on top of its own contrasting background or translucent panel. Compose the image naturally across the full canvas with balanced visual interest.
quoteLayouts.composition: Use a complete edge-to-edge composition without deliberately creating empty quote space.

globalInstructions: The selected style profile is authoritative. Do not combine visual styles from different profiles.
Generate the image for the mood itself, not for an individual quotation.
The resulting background should be reusable across many different quotations sharing the same mood.
Do not infer or depict the semantic subject matter of any specific quotation.
Mood and visual style are independent. Serene does not imply pastel, watercolor, softness, or bright colours.
Interpret the mood through composition, light, spatial feeling, colour, texture, form, atmosphere, and intensity while preserving the chosen style.
Prefer atmospheric, abstract, environmental, textural, geometric, or non-narrative imagery over a specific story or scene.
Avoid prominent symbolic foreground objects because symbolic elements may be composited separately during final rendering.
Avoid generic fantasy concept art and generic AI illustration aesthetics.
Avoid making every spiritual, philosophical, or transcendent mood into a galaxy or outer-space scene.
Avoid making every dark mood cyberpunk.
Avoid making every psychedelic image rainbow-coloured.
Avoid obvious rectangular empty panels for quotation space.
A reserved quotation region should still contain subtle colour, atmosphere, gradients, or extremely low-detail texture.
The strongest focal element should normally remain outside the reserved quotation region.
Keep the composition suitable for repeated use behind overlaid typography.
Do not generate text or pseudo-text.

selectionRules.styleSelection: Select exactly one style profile using weighted random selection from styleProfiles.
selectionRules.mediumSelection: Select one medium only from the chosen style profile.
selectionRules.lookSelection: Select one look only from the chosen style profile.
selectionRules.textureSelection: Select one texture only from the chosen style profile.
selectionRules.quoteLayoutSelection: Select exactly one quote layout using weighted random selection from quoteLayouts.
selectionRules.randomness: Random selections must be performed by application code, not delegated to the language model.
selectionRules.overlayBehavior: When quoteLayouts.id is overlay, do not add any other instruction about leaving blank or quiet space for quotation text.
selectionRules.reservedAreaBehavior: For all layouts except overlay, the reserved area must be low-detail but visually continuous with the rest of the image.
selectionRules.safeMargins: Quote space refers to an interior region. Do not interpret left, right, top or bottom as extending typography space all the way to the canvas edge.
